answer: Bond-weighted attestation: each new identity must lock 50 POA in a vault for 30 days before its attestations count. If any of its approvals is later shown to be fraudulent, the bond is slashed, and the penalty ripples back to every identity that vouched for it. A farm of 1,000 sybils therefore ties up 50,000 POA and risks losing all of it on a single bad call, so cheap fake accounts become a costly relic rather than a profitable attack.
